## Problem or goal

Who needs this, and what can they not do today? Describe the user outcome,
not just a proposed implementation. Check vision.md for intended behaviour.

## Proposed change

Describe the smallest useful improvement. Name the affected skill, component,
or Mission Stage using CONTEXT.md's language. Ideas need not include code.

## Alternatives and boundaries

What workarounds or other approaches did you consider? What is out of scope?
Call out compatibility, trust, or unattended-execution implications.

## Observable acceptance criteria

How could a contributor prove the idea works? Include a concrete example and
the expected outcome. Please omit private source, credentials, and personal data.
